All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks (error rate 0.18) after the latest deploy of **v2.3.1** to production.

**Investigation:**
- Current production version: v2.3.1 — **unhealthy** in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west)
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy, while the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older)

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollback completed successfully.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", documenting the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicates.)

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is back on **v2.3.0**, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.002.

**Note:** The unhealthy v2.3.1 release should be investigated before any future redeploy attempt.
